mapper.select: SELECT version_id AS versionId, version_code AS versionCode, data_hash AS dataHash, published_at AS publishedAt, COALESCE(published_at, created_at) AS updatedAt FROM public.game_versions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND is_current = true AND data_hash IS NOT NULL ORDER BY version_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT version_id AS versionId, version_code AS versionCode, COALESCE(data_hash, '') AS dataHash, published_at AS publishedAt, COALESCE(published_at, created_at) AS updatedAt FROM public.game_versions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND version_id = #{versionId} LIMIT 1
SELECT version_id FROM public.game_versions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND is_current = true ORDER BY version_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT version_id FROM public.game_versions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY version_id DESC LIMIT 1
